record.question: Ministry of Ayush, Government of India was set up in the year
record.explanation: Answer C: 2014. The Department of Indian Systems of Medicine and Homoeopathy (ISM&H) was set up in 1995, renamed the Department of AYUSH in 2003, and elevated to the Ministry of AYUSH on 9 November 2014. Therefore the ministry was set up in 2014. Reference: https://ayush.gov.in/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
